title_sq: Tek 21 Dhjetori, Shitet Apartament 2+1, Me Hapesira Te Bollshme Dhe Orientim Perfekt !!
description_sq: Tek 21 Dhjetori, Shitet Apartament 2+1, Me Hapesira Te Bollshme Dhe Orientim Perfekt !! Apartamenti me siperfaqe 103 m2 Neto, ndodhet ne katin e 3 banim te nje ndertimi te ri me ashensor. Eshte mundesi ideale per banim dhe Investim referuar zones ku ndodhet dhe aksesit me zonat qendrore te Tiranes. Apartamenti strukturohet ne ambientin e livingut , dy dhoma gjumi dhe tualeti. I gjithe apartamenti ka orientim Jug-Lindje, gje qe e ben te ndricuar dhe te ngrohte gjate gjithe dites. Duke qene kati i 3 dhe me pamje nga rruga, mund te sherbej shume mire edhe per klinike dentare ose zyra. Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor .
title_en: Until December 21, 2+1 apartment for sale, with ample space and perfect orientation!!
description_en: Until December 21, 2+1 apartment for sale, with ample space and perfect orientation!! The apartment with a surface area of ​​103 m2 Net, is located on the 3rd residential floor of a new building with an elevator. It is the ideal opportunity for residence and investment, referring to the area where it is located and the access to the central areas of Tirana. The apartment consists of a living room, two bedrooms and a bathroom. The entire apartment has a South-East orientation, which makes it bright and warm throughout the day. Being on the 3rd floor and overlooking the street, it can also serve very well for dental clinics or offices. Has regular mortgage documentation.
